proposed_urls.rationale: 42.17.370 Commission -- Additional powers — PDC authority including suspension/modification of reporting requirements (pre-reorg analog of 42.17A.120).
42.17.150 Registration of lobbyists — central lobbyist-registration requirement (pre-reorg analog of 42.17A.600).
42.17.155 Photograph and information -- Booklet -- Publication (pre-reorg analog of 42.17A.605).
42.17.170 Reporting by lobbyists — periodic lobbyist activity/expenditure reports (pre-reorg analog of 42.17A.615).
42.17.172 Notification to person named in report (pre-reorg analog of 42.17A.620).
42.17.175 Special reports -- Lobbyists -- Late contributions or large totals (pre-reorg analog of 42.17A.625).
42.17.180 Reports by employers of registered lobbyists, other persons (pre-reorg analog of 42.17A.630).
42.17.190 Legislative activities of state agencies, other units of government, elective officials, employees — public-sector lobbying disclosure (pre-reorg analog of 42.17A.635).
42.17.200 Grass roots lobbying campaigns — indirect-lobbying disclosure requirement (pre-reorg analog of 42.17A.640).
42.17.210 Employment of legislators, board or commission members, or state employees -- Statement, contents and filing (pre-reorg analog of 42.17A.645).
42.17.220 Employment of unregistered persons (pre-reorg analog of 42.17A.650).
42.17.390 Civil remedies and sanctions — chapter-wide enforcement reaching lobbyist provisions (pre-reorg analog of 42.17A.750).
42.17.395 Violations -- Determination by commission -- Procedure (pre-reorg analog of 42.17A.755).
42.17.400 Enforcement — chapter-wide enforcement provision (pre-reorg analog of 42.17A.765).

notes: WA 2010 vintage is hosted on Justia ONLY as volume-level monolith pages — /codes/washington/2010/ exposes 18 'Volume N: Titles X through Y' URLs and zero browsable title/chapter/section URLs. Each volume page (e.g. /volume-5-titles-35a-through-42/, 7.7 MB) renders the full text of every title in that volume inline but provides no in-page navigation links — only a single PDF-download link. Probed candidates that all 404'd at vintage 2010: /codes/washington/2010/title-42/, /title42/, /Title42/, /42/, /42.17/, /title-42/chapter-42.17/, /title-42/42-17/, /title-42/42-17/42-17-150/. This explains the earlier 'silent-empty' canary outcome for WA 2010 — pass-1 had no actionable title URL to pick because none exist; the pass-1 link extractor correctly returns only volume URLs which then fail when descended into. SUBSTITUTED to actual_vintage_used=2009 (1 year off, within ±5 window). 2009 was chosen over 2011 because (a) RCW 42.17 was the chapter operatively in force throughout calendar 2010 — the 2010 c 204 consolidation that created RCW 42.17A had a January 1, 2012 effective date — and 2009 Justia hosts the full pre-reorg RCW 42.17 chapter as a browsable directory with 110 per-section leaves; 2011 hosts the post-reorg structure with most of 42.17's content already recodified into 42.17A. Tree depth=3 (state-index → title-42 → chapter-42-17 → section-leaf, with the chapter directory itself being the pass-3 fetch target). Per-section leaf convention (Wisconsin Example D shape) — same shape as the WA 2015 bundle, just mapped onto the pre-reorg chapter. 17 URLs selected — TWO fewer than WA 2015's 19, because the 2009 chapter listing begins at 42.17.030 and does not expose 42.17.020 (Definitions, the pre-reorg analog of 42.17A.005) or any analog of 42.17A.020 (Statements/reports public records) as individual section leaves; the 42.17A consolidation chapter at 2009 DOES expose 42.17A.005 but it is NOT operative at vintage 2010 so out of scope. Per WA Code Reviser's 2012 reorg table, the 17 URLs map to 17 of the 19 in the 2015 bundle: .150↔.600, .155↔.605, .160↔.610, .170↔.615, .172↔.620, .175↔.625, .180↔.630, .190↔.635, .200↔.640, .210↔.645, .220↔.650, .230↔.655 (core lobbying), .370↔.120 (PDC additional-powers / suspension-modification), .390↔.750, .395↔.755, .400↔.765, .410↔.770 (enforcement / limitations). No Cloudflare/Playwright errors. intermediate_volume-5.html/tsv preserved as evidence of the unbrowsable 2010 volume structure.
